Use case: historical-scene.
Asset type: Matkakirja Paris arrival image number 8, a new BLACK AND WHITE photograph-like reconstruction of Pont Royal and the Tuileries ruins in the year 1873. One image only, 1536x1024 opaque.
Image roles: Image1 is my generated present-day Pont Royal river view, used ONLY to match the left-bank eye-level camera position and five-arch bridge/river framing. Its restored far-right Louvre/Pavillon roof is NOT historical evidence and MUST NOT be retained. Image2 is Pierre Emonts's July1871 public-domain/CC0 Musée Carnavalet photo PH17352: factual source for the burnt Pavillon de Flore and adjacent Tuileries ruin, especially its exposed burnt open roof framework and surviving chimney masonry. Image3 is Carnavalet PH34628 from1883: factual supporting evidence for standing roofless Tuileries walls only; do not copy1883 demolition work or its camera angle. All are visual/factual references, not images to edit. No source pixels, museum photo framing, annotations, paper border, sepia or text reproduced.
Camera and scene: the same general LEFT BANK river position as Image1 looking across the Seine at Pont Royal, eye height about3m above low-quay level, normal40mm lens. Five real modest low stone arches aligned horizontally across the middle of frame, river foreground, diagonal simple stone quay lower right, opposite riverbank and the old Tuileries site behind. Plausible small wood workboat or unmarked nineteenth-century steam launch is enough, no modern boats; no people or faces necessary.
CRITICAL YEAR1873 ROOF CONDITION: behind the opposite-bank trees the standing Tuileries palace wings are an abandoned burnt ruin after the1871 fire, long old masonry walls with black empty window openings, collapsed floors, broken parapets and NO INTACT ROOF. The taller PAVILLON DE FLORE AT THE FAR RIGHT MUST ALSO HAVE A BURNT-DAMAGED ROOF: open skeletal partly collapsed old roof rafters and standing large pale chimney stacks as in Image2, gaps clearly exposing pale sky through the missing roofing. Do NOT draw the smooth intact high slate mansard roof, clean continuous roof slopes, decorative intact ridge, completed restored roof or modern Louvre silhouette from Image1. This is before1874–1876 restoration. The surviving pavilion facade can stand but its roof is distinctly incomplete and wrecked, not restored. The original long central Tuileries ruins remain present in1873; no claim that demolition has already removed them.

Soft restrained contrast, very subtle fine photographic grain and barely perceptible natural lens-edge darkening; not old paper, damage, heavy vignetting or an illustration. Quiet pale natural daylight with believable soft shadows, organic irregular stone, wood and water ripple textures, mild period harbour haze.

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Generate one completely NEW original full-colour present-day candid documentary photograph, visibly real-camera quality, landscape 1536 x 1024 opaque RGB sRGB PNG. Natural subdued colours, ordinary human eye-level perspective, plausible single-camera geometry, realistic scale and physical textures. No food advertising look or posed product still-life. Natural irregular detail rather than cloned/embossed vegetation, repeating stamped organic surfaces, CGI, illustration, artificial HDR or cinematic grading. No text, letters, digits, signage, menus, shop boards, logos, brands, watermarks, borders, frames or identifiable faces. Do not depict protected contemporary artworks/design products or reproduce an existing photograph.
Scene: a quiet ordinary afternoon beside the broad shallow octagonal central basin of Jardin du Luxembourg, Paris, viewed from its pale stone rim at normal standing eye height, 35mm camera. Primary subject: everyday readers relaxing near the basin. Three or four simple ANONYMOUS OLD-FASHIONED green painted iron garden chairs are informally scattered on pale gravel; one back-facing adult sits in the nearer left chair reading a small blank-covered book mostly hidden by their body, another back-facing adult sits farther away, and a tiny child well in the distance by the opposite rim is seen from behind. No faces anywhere. Chair construction MUST be generic straight iron geometry that predates modern designer products: slender tubular/rod iron frame, simple straight four legs, narrow VERTICAL round iron rods in the back, plain functional seat, NO broad curved horizontal back/seat slats, NO contemporary ergonomic design-chair shapes, NO brands or logos. This is an anonymous illustrative historical-type park chair, not a replica of the actual branded present-day chairs. Natural worn green paint and very modest rust, no ornate decorative designs. The basin occupies the middle/right of frame, with believable shallow water and low clipped simple stone rim; its straight octagonal edges appear correctly foreshortened from eye height. Broad garden paths and mature chestnut trees provide the upper background, soft dappled late-afternoon light, natural irregular leaves and branches. Face the camera toward the tree-lined part of the garden so the Luxembourg Palace, sculpted statues, plinths and decorative artworks are ALL OUT OF FRAME. No kiosks, signs, awnings or printed clothing. A calm spontaneous park photograph with credible chair/person scale and varied gravel/tree/water texture, not a formal symmetrical postcard.

Near readers face away; tiny background heads have no identifiable facial features in native crops. Credible person/chair scale, varied natural gravel/foliage/trunk/water textures. Octagonal rim is partly foreshortened/cropped, palace and sculptures excluded; no named chair-product or exact photographic reconstruction claimed.

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Generate a COMPLETELY NEW original documentary travel photograph, colour 1536 x 1024 opaque RGB sRGB PNG, visibly photographed with a real camera during an ordinary happy summer evening beside Canal Saint-Martin in Paris. Not a food image. One coherent physical scene, not a pasted portrait, collage, fashion advertising image or composited background.
Scene and framing: narrow straight canal, old worn stone/quay paving and leafy plane trees, small relaxed groups of young adults sitting on the canal-edge paving with their friends. A modest generic acoustic guitar is played quietly by a friend farther along the bank; small warm anonymous lanterns and a subtle short string of plain lights decorate the gathering, with plenty of natural late-evening sky light still present. No large landmarks, no Eiffel Tower, no Notre-Dame, no sculptures/artworks, commercial façades, posters or storefronts.
Primary foreground subject: ONE entirely fictional woman about 26 years old, naturally laughing with her friends rather than posing for the photographer. Waist-up or half-body view in the nearer RIGHT third, at about two metres from the camera, turned slightly LEFT toward a friend sitting beside her. She has an ordinary human face with fine real skin texture, small natural asymmetries and a spontaneous gentle open-mouth laugh, normal teeth and expressive eyes; no beauty retouch, waxy/plastic smoothness or glamour lighting. A plain contemporary cotton overshirt over a simple fashionable neutral top, no distinctive designer style or label. Her body, arms and any visible hands are naturally supported by the quay seating, with plausible elbows/wrists/fingers, not detached or unnaturally gripping props. Several friends about 22–32 years old in varied ordinary modern unbranded summer clothing occupy the same bank at middle distance, interacting naturally. All people are fictional adults, no real-person/celebrity likeness or references, plausibly ordinary contemporary Paris locals with natural individual variation rather than stereotypes.
Camera: observer eye height around 1.5m, a 35mm lens around f/5.6, ISO about 1000, subtle normal documentary grain; moderate natural depth of field lets the environment and friends remain substantial and readable, no artificial extreme portrait bokeh, edge halos, separate subject spotlights or focus stacking. Foreground skin/clothing and friends/bank share the SAME soft twilight illumination, slight warm lantern spill only near the actual lanterns, realistic contact shadows and appropriate object scales. The canal leads away through the frame, its small water ripples/reflections physically irregular; tree bark/leaves/stone have varied natural detail, no repetitive embossed, stamped or cloned patterns. Authentic candid social atmosphere, quiet acoustic music, laughter and conversation.
Constraints: no text, letters, digits, signs, notices, menus, logos, brands, printed clothing, named modern design products, watermarks, frame or source-photograph reproduction. Guitar is a plain anonymous traditional acoustic instrument without lettering or brand-shaped headstock. No alcohol bottles or alcohol-focused props; if any small plain glass is present it is secondary water/lemonade, not the main subject. No children, no violence, no dramatic concert stage, no cinematic HDR grading, cartoon/painterly/CGI appearance. Create the FULL image fresh; no input images or reuse of any old food/event candidate.
